title: Matrix family structural COM probe: pinned values, provisional tier, no count
status_plain: Native Excel COM probe rows on 2026-03-16 pinned square-matrix, scalar-1x1, singular-inverse and nonnumeric-cell lanes for the matrix family, including MDETERM({1,2;3,4}) -> -2, MINVERSE(5) -> 0.2, MMULT(5,2) -> 10 and MMULT({1,2;3,4},{5;6;7}) -> #VALUE!. The registry tier is provisional and no numerator or denominator is published. So a structural Excel comparison IS on record for all three surfaces - "no record names this function" is not true of MDETERM or MMULT - but no row count was extracted and none can be. Separately, the discrepancy catalogue records that MINVERSE(5) and MMULT(5,2) are deliberately absent from the Category-2 comparison boundary: nested TYPE evidence proves their function results remain 1x1 arrays and Excel's final-cell scalar appearance belongs to the Category-1 worksheet publication seam, tracked as publication_shape rows CSC-0024 and CSC-0025 with downstream handoff HO-FN-010.
